rule.title: Prohibition on Source of Lawful Income Discrimination
rule.requirement: [Basis: official explanatory text, not operative legal text] Landlords are prohibited from discriminating in housing based on a tenant's source of lawful income or rent payment. A landlord cannot deny a lawful recipient of a Section 8 HUD voucher the right to rent an apartment based solely on that source of lawful income.
rule.coverage_conditions: The provisions of the Law Against Discrimination apply to the sale or rental of all property including open land, whether for business or residential purposes. [Question 4]
rule.exemptions: The LAD does not apply to the rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family dwelling where the other unit is occupied by the owner as their residence at the time of the rental. [Question 4]; The LAD does not apply to the rental of a room or rooms to another person by the owner or occupant of a one-family dwelling occupied by them as their residence at the time of the rental. [Question 4]
